title: Make every roadmap verification task closable, on evidence or on a refutation
goal: The 30 verification tasks I minted demand a test that proves the vector, so a vector that turns out NOT to be delivered leaves its agent unable to close and holding a dead claim - a stall I created. Record the outcome instead, one file per vector, so refutation is a result: .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<VC-id>.json with verdict delivered (requires the test or evidence that proves it) or not-delivered (requires what is missing and the follow-up task ids that track it), plus who recorded it and when. The acceptance becomes scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <VC-id>, which passes on either complete verdict and says what a incomplete one lacks; its --self-test pins all four cases. The roadmap queue checker counts a recorded verdict as resolved, so the queue cannot look dry while a verdict is on file, and one file per vector keeps 30 concurrent agents off a single roadmap.json (hand-resolved conflicts are what stranded the swarm-gap branch).
